title: Resource ingestion worker validation plan
description: Documents worker-level assertions for the completed Stage 7 resource ingestion claim and validation lifecycle.
subject: apps/worker/src/resource-ingestion
preconditions: a resource ingestion job exists with status queued
the job payload references an uploaded student-owned resource
the resource storage object exists for the success path
the worker runtime is configured with service-role database access
the worker runtime is configured with storage inspection access

expected: locked_by is set to worker id
heartbeat_at updates for the claimed job
resource lifecycle_state is uploaded before validation
content hash matches payload when present
byte size matches payload and inspected object
declared MIME type matches inspected object
